subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: An agency wants to secure an additional 100 hours of user training. The software vendor agrees to provide the training at no extra cost, provided the agency agrees to sign a 3-year term instead of a 1-year term. This exchange is known as a:
questions.explain: A concession or trade-off occurs when one party yields on a point of interest (like term length) to gain value on another point of interest (like training hours), which is a core component of principled negotiations.
